csv_project_name: Structural Engineering Services for HDC Program
csv_scope_of_work: Harris County Toll Road Authority (HCTRA) invites professional firms with experience, qualifications, capabilities, and available staff to submit qualifications to provide Professional Engineering Services for the Hardy Downtown Connector (HDC) Program. HCTRA plans to make multiple selections to award contracts to Segment Design Consultants (SDCs) based on firms evidence of their ability to provide complete, thorough, and comprehensive responses and information that demonstrate the most highly competent and qualified provider to develop complete Plans, Specifications, and Estimates (PS&E) for the Roadway and Structural Segments of the HDC Program.

title: Structural Engineering Services for HDC Program
short_description: Engineering services for roadway and structural segment design of Houston's Hardy Downtown Connector program.
project_scope: Professional engineering services for the Hardy Downtown Connector (HDC) Program for Harris County Toll Road Authority. The authority intends to award multiple contracts to Segment Design Consultants to develop complete Plans, Specifications, and Estimates (PS&E) for roadway and structural segments. No technical dimensions, spans, lengths, or structural types are stated in the notice.
services: Professional engineering services for roadway and structural segment design; preparation of complete PS&E documents; likely multidisciplinary design support for transportation infrastructure.
relevance_explanation:
- Includes structural engineering services for transportation infrastructure, which is generally relevant to sbp.
- Scope explicitly covers structural segments, suggesting bridge or civil structure design components.
- Multiple consultant selections may offer strategic entry opportunities.
- However, the notice is broad program-level procurement without specific bridge types, spans, or architecturally demanding structures.
- Strong roadway/highway focus reduces certainty of fit compared with clearly defined special bridges or long-span structures.
- No explicit sustainability, innovation, lightweight structures, or unusual structural systems are mentioned.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The procurement concerns professional engineering services for a toll road connector program with roadway and structural segments in Houston, but no lengths, segment counts, bridge sizes, or cost ranges are provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible from the available text.
fee_explanation: No design fee or engineering budget is stated in the notice. Only a 36-month contract duration and multiple consultant awards are mentioned; without construction cost, scope quantities, or fee schedule, no reliable fee estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Professional firms must demonstrate experience, qualifications, capabilities, and available staff. Selection is based on evidence of ability to provide complete, thorough, and comprehensive responses and to develop complete PS&E for roadway and structural segments. No specific minimum number or type of reference projects is stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: Most highly competent and qualified provider based on complete, thorough, and comprehensive responses and demonstrated ability to develop complete PS&E for roadway and structural segments. No weighting is stated in the provided text.
